name: agentic-cognitive-writing-process
description: Agentic CogWriter plugins for writing projects and controlled comparisons.

plugins.name: agentic-cognitive-writing
plugins.description: Agentic CogWriter is a harness that turns a coding agent into a cognitive writing system by installing skills and subagents that run long-form writing as an explicit cognitive process and keep goals, drafts, notes, and the decision log as files.

plugins.name: cognitive-writing-experiments
plugins.description: Controlled process variants for comparing writing-process choices, including fixed process order and removal of the hierarchical goal network.

plugins.name: cognitive-writing-baselines
plugins.description: Baseline writing conditions for controlled comparisons using the same assignment, context, model settings, output budget, and no-retrieval policy.
